title: Interpolate Curve Vertex Move Sync
description: When calling interpolate curve after moving a vertex, the curve does not update. Fix live point resolution from snapped vertices during the command and sync nurbs through-curve poles when endpoint vertices move on committed geometry.
summary: Interpolate curve kept stale geometry after vertex moves because interaction `points` were frozen at click time and committed NURBS edges stored through-points only in `edge.curve.poles`, not on endpoint vertices. `command.addPoint` now records parallel `pointSnaps`; commit and display resolve live vertex positions; `applyModelDiff` updates nurbs `through` edge poles when endpoint vertices move. Added core regression tests for both flows.
